item.text: The current parser uses `parseInt`, which accepts prefixes such as `"12x"` and loses exactness for unsafe integers. I’m checking the focused test file and will add boundary and malformed-string cases while preserving the reason gate and message behavior.

The parser now validates the whole string against the canonical decimal form and checks `Number.isSafeInteger`; regression cases cover malformed forms, unsafe values, and the maximum safe integer. I’ll run the requested frontend lint and test commands.
